summary: Frontend-only prototype of Robson Club tested end-to-end on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) via public URL. All 13 review-request test cases pass: influencer dashboard (greeting, 4 KPIs, chart, QR/coupon, Top Parceiros, Campanhas Ativas, search/status filters, empty state, share toasts, period selector recalculates KPIs 1284→3467), role switcher (dropdown, influencer/partner/admin routes), partner dashboard (5 KPIs, coupon preview, live discount/commission for 100€ = 15€/10€, validate updates receipt+KPI+history, invalid coupon toast, expired coupon toast, scanner modal auto-fill ROBSON-LUXE-25 after 2.2s, CSV export), admin dashboard shows audit entry REDENÇÃO immediately after partner validation in same session (in-memory context preserved as expected), ComingSoon route works for /mensagens and /ebooks, mobile menu toggle opens drawer sidebar.

issues: Expired coupon toast reads 'Cupom expirada — não pode ser redimido.' — Portuguese gender agreement: should be 'expirado' (masculine, agreeing with 'Cupom'). Minor copy issue in AppContext.jsx validateCoupon (line 18) which lowercases status value directly. Cosmetic only.

action_items: OPTIONAL (cosmetic): In /app/frontend/src/context/AppContext.jsx line 18, fix gender agreement for status message (e.g. map 'Expirada' → 'expirado', 'Pausada' → 'pausado') so error reads 'Cupom expirado — não pode ser redimido.'
critical_code_review_comments: AppContext memoization: useMemo deps include 'processedTx' (a Set) — Set identity changes on every add so memo works, but consider using a ref or count to keep stable identity across other renders. Non-blocking.
validateCoupon idempotency key uses Math.floor(Date.now()/5000) — creates a 5s window collision. Adequate for demo but real system should use a client-generated UUID per submit-click.

eur() formatter switches maximumFractionDigits based on whether value % 1 === 0 — leads to inconsistent 2dp/0dp mixing in the same UI (e.g. '15 €' vs '15,00 €'). Consider forcing 2dp for monetary values in receipts/live-calculations.

PARTNER_COUPONS in mockData.js only lists 4 codes but CAMPAIGNS references 5 unique coupon codes (e.g. ROBSON-BEL-10, ROBSON-YEAT-20, ROBSON-VITA-15 are not in PARTNER_COUPONS). Partner validation of campaign coupons from the Campanhas table will fail with 'não encontrado'. May be intentional (partner only sees own coupons) but worth confirming.
seed_data_creation: None — client-side mock data used as-is from /app/frontend/src/lib/mockData.js
context_for_next_testing_agent: Prototype is fully functional per spec. All data-testid selectors from review request exist and behave as documented. Core money loop (coupon → preview → live-calc → validate → receipt → KPI update → audit log) verified end-to-end within a single browser session. Note: page reloads reset in-memory state — audit must be viewed by clicking role-switcher (not by page.goto reload).
